caption:
Google just gave you a shortcut for review replies.

Maps now lets businesses react to a review with an emoji instead of writing a reply. Right now it only works inside the Google Maps mobile app; desktop still shows the old "like" button.

Fine for the one-line five-star reviews that don't need a paragraph back. The wrong tool for anything with a real question or a complaint attached.

The reviews that move readers into calls still need words: specifics about what the customer said and how you fixed it. React to the easy ones. Write the rest.

The Black Arrow platform's review engine requests, tracks, and centralizes every reply in one inbox, so nothing gets a lazy react when it needed a real answer. See it running on your own reviews. 14 days free.
